entries.reviewSummary: Governs motor vehicle registration applications, vehicle descriptions, odometer recordkeeping, reconstructed titles, and voluntary donations.

headings.title: Motor vehicle registration application contents
headings.reviewNote: Requires annual registration application detailing vehicle description, identification number, owner, and gross weight.

headings.title: Business vehicle odometer record retention
headings.reviewNote: Requires director of revenue to retain odometer information for business vehicles under ten years old.

headings.title: Nonbusiness vehicle odometer record retention
headings.reviewNote: Requires retaining odometer records for passenger vehicles under ten years old with under 150,000 miles.

headings.title: Application requirements for reconstructed vehicles
headings.reviewNote: Requires title surrender, inspections, parts invoices, and photographs for reconstructed or salvage vehicles.

headings.title: Insurer notice and report for salvage vehicles
headings.reviewNote: Requires insurers paying reconstructed or retained-salvage claims to notify owners and lienholders of title surrender duties and report to the director within thirty days.

headings.title: Class B misdemeanor for registration noncompliance
headings.reviewNote: Classifies failure to comply with the requirements of this section as a class B misdemeanor.

headings.title: Voluntary donation for blindness assistance
headings.reviewNote: Permits a voluntary one-dollar donation to the blindness education, screening and treatment program fund, with up to one percent retained for administrative costs.

headings.title: Voluntary donation for organ donor program
headings.reviewNote: Permits a voluntary donation of at least one dollar to the organ donor program fund, with up to one percent retained for administrative costs.

headings.title: Voluntary donation for medal of honor fund
headings.reviewNote: Permits a voluntary one-dollar donation to the Missouri medal of honor recipients fund, with up to one percent retained for administrative costs.

entries.reviewSummary: Requires proof of personal property tax payment prior to vehicle registration, regulates tax receipts, and establishes nonpayment suspension procedures.

headings.title: Personal property tax receipt required for registration
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits issuing registration without proof that preceding personal property taxes have been paid.

headings.title: Priority tax receipts for January renewals
headings.reviewNote: Requires collectors in counties of 600,000 to 900,000 population to prioritize tax receipts for January expirations and allows prior-year receipts for December new-vehicle purchases.

headings.title: Federal heavy vehicle use tax proof required
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits registering vehicles subject to the federal heavy vehicle use tax under IRC section 4481 without proof of payment or non-liability.

headings.title: Registration suspension for delinquent property taxes
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes collector notice and director suspension for unpaid personal property taxes beginning July 1, 2000, with a twenty-dollar reinstatement fee and thirty-day circuit court appeal.

headings.title: Notice of unpaid municipal vehicle fees or fines
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes certain cities to notify vehicle owners of delinquent vehicle-related fees or parking fines.

headings.title: City notice to director of revenue for nonpayment
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes city to notify director of revenue upon owner failure to pay delinquent vehicle fines.

headings.title: Registration suspension and reinstatement fee
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes director to suspend registration for unpaid city fines, requiring twenty-dollar reinstatement fee.

headings.title: City reimbursement of department administrative costs
headings.reviewNote: Requires participating municipalities to reimburse department of revenue for administrative suspension costs.

headings.title: Administrative rulemaking compliance standards
headings.reviewNote: Conditions validity of administrative rules on compliance with chapter 536 administrative procedures.

entries.reviewSummary: Exempts agricultural chemical sprayers and fertilizer spreaders from motor vehicle titling, registration, and license plate requirements.

headings.title: Registration exemption for agricultural chemical sprayers
headings.reviewNote: Permits operating self-propelled chemical sprayers and fertilizer spreaders on highways without registration.

headings.title: Exemption applies to laden or unladen vehicles
headings.reviewNote: Extends registration and plate exemptions to agricultural implements whether laden or unladen.

headings.title: Applicability of general motor vehicle safety laws
headings.reviewNote: Applies all other general motor vehicle operating laws to agricultural implements on highways.

headings.title: Implement of husbandry defined for chemical sprayers
headings.reviewNote: Defines implement of husbandry as low-speed machinery adapted for agricultural chemical application.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes monthly series registration periods for noncommercial vehicles, commercial vehicle registration schedules, and motorcycle expiration dates.

headings.title: Monthly series registration system for noncommercial vehicles
headings.reviewNote: Establishes twelve rolling monthly registration periods and provides grace period before late penalties.

headings.title: Initial registration fee calculation by mid-month
headings.reviewNote: Sets fee calculations based on operation before or after the fifteenth day of the month.

headings.title: Commercial motor vehicle registration and plate markings
headings.reviewNote: Governs annual calendar-year and prorated commercial registrations, reflective plates, and farm 'F' markings.

headings.title: Registration for nine thousand pound commercial vehicles
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes issuing nine thousand pound gross weight commercial plates at twelve thousand pound fee rates.

headings.title: June thirtieth expiration for motorcycle registrations
headings.reviewNote: Establishes that all motorcycle and motortricycle registrations expire annually on June thirtieth.

entries.reviewSummary: Authorizes fleet vehicle registration system, multiyear registrations, permanent plates, inspection exemptions, and leasing fleet provisions.

headings.title: Fleet registration system authorized for fleet owners
headings.reviewNote: Directs establishment of a fleet registration system for owners of ten or more vehicles on an annual or biennial basis, issuing a fleet identification number.

headings.title: April fleet registration and quarterly proration
headings.reviewNote: Requires April fleet registration, 120-day safety inspection certificates, and quarterly prorated fees for vehicles added during the year.

headings.title: Mid-year fleet additions and transfer fee
headings.reviewNote: Allows adding or transferring vehicles to a fleet during the calendar year using the fleet ID number with a two-dollar transfer fee.

headings.title: Multiyear fleet plates and optional logo plates
headings.reviewNote: Provides reflective multiyear 'Fleet Vehicle' plates without renewal tabs, optional company logo plates for fifty-vehicle fleets at five dollars each, and in-vehicle payment proof.

headings.title: Inspection exemption for out-of-state fleet vehicles
headings.reviewNote: Exempts Missouri-registered fleet vehicles situated outside Missouri at annual registration from sections 307.350 to 307.390 safety inspections.

headings.title: Fleet registration for large rental and leasing companies
headings.reviewNote: Permits rental or leasing companies with 3,500 or more vehicles to operate as registered fleet owners at $360 for the first ten plates and $36 per additional plate, without presenting inspections.

headings.title: Annual or biennial registration and agent fees
headings.reviewNote: Requires licensed lease or rental fleet owners to register annually or biennially, doubling plate fees and agent fees for biennial registration.

headings.title: Proof of insurance for rental fleet plates
headings.reviewNote: Requires applicants for fleet plates under subsections 6 to 10 to provide proof of insurance under section 303.024 or 303.026.

headings.title: Expiration of rental fleet owner authority
headings.reviewNote: Provides that a lease or rental company's authority to operate as a fleet owner expires on January first of the licensure period.

headings.title: Availability of rental fleet registration records
headings.reviewNote: Requires lease or rental companies operating fleet plates to provide corresponding vehicle and registration information upon request to the director and Missouri law enforcement.

headings.title: Director of revenue rulemaking authority for fleets
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes director of revenue to promulgate rules and regulations administering fleet registration.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes monthly series registration periods, conversion schedules, and fee proration for light commercial vehicles.

headings.title: Monthly registration for light commercial vehicles
headings.reviewNote: Mandates monthly series registration system for commercial motor vehicles licensed for twelve thousand pounds or less.

headings.title: Staggered registration periods during initial conversion
headings.reviewNote: Allocates commercial vehicles among staggered initial periods ranging from six to seventeen months.

headings.title: Proration of fees for light commercial vehicles
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes prorated fees for light commercial registrations paid in accordance with section 301.030.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs annual and staggered quarterly commercial motor vehicle and trailer reciprocity registrations, renewal deadlines, installment payments, plate display, and permanent trailer plates.

headings.title: Annual and staggered quarterly commercial registrations
headings.reviewNote: Provides annual or staggered quarterly registration for commercial motor vehicles and trailers under this section or reciprocity agreements, with transition and fleet-addition proration.

headings.title: Renewal application deadline and late penalty
headings.reviewNote: Requires renewal applications three calendar months before the registration start date, imposing a waivable one-hundred-dollar late penalty.

headings.title: Renewal fee deadline and vehicle penalties
headings.reviewNote: Requires renewal fee payment one calendar month before registration begins, imposing a waivable fifty-dollar per-vehicle penalty capped at one hundred fifty dollars per application.

headings.title: Two-installment payment option with security
headings.reviewNote: Permits paying the Missouri portion of annual fees in two equal installments of at least one hundred dollars, backed by a surety bond, certificate of deposit, or irrevocable letter of credit.

headings.title: Bar on temporary registration for delinquencies
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits issuing temporary registrations to applicants delinquent on renewal documents, fees, or penalties, while allowing temporary credentials for post-renewal fleet additions.

headings.title: Front plate display deadline and misdemeanor penalty
headings.reviewNote: Requires affixing plates to the front of the vehicle by December thirty-first or the preceding quarter's end, classifying failure to display as a class A misdemeanor.

headings.title: Commission rulemaking authority
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the highways and transportation commission to prescribe rules and regulations for administering this section.

headings.title: Permanent registrations remain valid despite pact changes
headings.reviewNote: Protects validity of permanent registrations even if reciprocity agreements alter apportionment terms.

headings.title: Commission authority to issue permanent trailer plates
headings.reviewNote: Empowers commission to issue permanent and temporary registrations to carriers registering power units.

headings.title: Conformity and plate legend for commercial trailers
headings.reviewNote: Specifies plate design standards and authorizes using the legend 'COMM TRL' on plates.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes graduated annual registration fees for passenger motor vehicles based on horsepower and fees for autocycles and motorcycles.

headings.title: Graduated registration fees based on horsepower
headings.reviewNote: Sets registration fee schedule based on horsepower ratings, motorcycles, and autocycles.

headings.title: Grandfathered autocycle motorcycle registrations
headings.reviewNote: Allows prior autocycle motorcycle registrations to remain valid until next annual renewal.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes graduated annual registration fees for local commercial motor vehicles based on gross weight and penalizes improper registration.

headings.title: Graduated registration fees for local commercial vehicles
headings.reviewNote: Prescribes fee schedule based on gross weight tiers up to eighty thousand pounds.

headings.title: Penalties for improper heavy vehicle registration
headings.reviewNote: Imposes full calendar year fees for improperly registering vehicles exceeding fifty-four thousand pounds.

entries.reviewSummary: Sets annual registration fees for local log trucks and authorizes extended distance permits for transport beyond standard radius.

headings.title: Annual registration fee for local log trucks
headings.reviewNote: Establishes three hundred dollar annual registration fee for qualifying local log trucks.

headings.title: Extended distance permit for forest products
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes extended distance permit for additional three hundred dollars to transport forest products.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes registration fees for land improvement contractors' commercial motor vehicles, maximum weight, and special plate design.

headings.title: Registration fee and weight limit for contractors
headings.reviewNote: Sets three hundred fifty dollar registration fee, eighty thousand pound limit, and bans for-hire transit.

headings.title: Application affidavit and contractor plate issuance
headings.reviewNote: Requires owner affidavit of restricted usage and directs issuance of distinctive contractor plates.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes trailer and semitrailer registration fees, three-year registration options, permanent plates, and recreational trailer due dates.

headings.title: Annual trailer and semitrailer registration fee
headings.reviewNote: Establishes seven dollar fifty cent annual fee and computes tractor combination fees on total weight.

headings.title: Three-year trailer registration option and fee
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes three-year trailer registration upon payment of twenty-two dollars and fifty cents.

headings.title: Permanent trailer registration option and fee
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes vehicle-specific permanent trailer registration for fifty-two dollars and fifty cents.

headings.title: May renewal period for recreational trailers
headings.reviewNote: Sets annual registration renewal for recreational trailers in the month of May.

entries.reviewSummary: Regulates driveaway license plates, allowable transit uses, fees, biennial options, application disclosures, and misdemeanor penalties.

headings.title: Driveaway license plate usage restrictions and fees
headings.reviewNote: Restricts driveaway plates to in-transit vehicle moves, sets fees, and permits biennial licenses.

headings.title: Mandatory driveaway plate application disclosures
headings.reviewNote: Requires application disclosing business and owner details, intended use, proof of financial responsibility, building photograph, and working business landline.

headings.title: Prompt reporting of changed application details
headings.reviewNote: Requires reporting changes in driveaway application information within ten days of occurrence.

headings.title: Revocation of driveaway plate for violations
headings.reviewNote: Mandates driveaway plate revocation and two-year reapplication ban for statutory noncompliance.

headings.title: Class A misdemeanor for using revoked plate
headings.reviewNote: Classifies knowingly operating vehicles with revoked driveaway plates as a class A misdemeanor.

entries.reviewSummary: Prescribes statutory formulas for computing internal combustion horsepower, steam ratings, electric vehicle ratings, and weight classifications.

headings.title: Formula for computing internal combustion horsepower
headings.reviewNote: Prescribes National Automobile Chamber of Commerce cylinder bore formula for computing horsepower.

headings.title: Horsepower determination for steam propelled vehicles
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes manufacturer rating or director regulations for determining steam vehicle horsepower.

headings.title: Horsepower rating for electric motor vehicles
headings.reviewNote: Rates noncommercial electric motor vehicles as being between twelve and twenty-four horsepower.

headings.title: Gross weight basis for commercial vehicle fees
headings.reviewNote: Bases commercial fees on maximum gross weight and tow truck fees on empty equipped weight.

headings.title: Finality of director vehicle classifications
headings.reviewNote: Establishes that director decisions regarding vehicle classification and fee computation are final.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs fractional fee computations for expired plates, affidavits of nonoperation, and registration proration for new vehicles.

headings.title: Fractional registration fee and nonoperation affidavit
headings.reviewNote: Calculates fractional fee for remaining months and requires nonoperation affidavit to avoid penalties.

headings.title: Fractional fee computation for newly acquired vehicles
headings.reviewNote: Computes fees for new or transferred vehicles based on unexpired months and nonoperation affidavits.

entries.reviewSummary: Authorizes initial fractional registrations for out-of-state vehicles and sets thirty-day registration deadline for new residents.

headings.title: Initial fractional registration for out-of-state vehicles
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes initial registrations of less than twelve months to balance monthly registration series.

headings.title: Subsequent twelve-month renewal periods
headings.reviewNote: Requires subsequent registrations to be renewed for standard twelve-month calendar periods.

headings.title: Thirty-day registration deadline for new residents
headings.reviewNote: Requires new Missouri residents to register out-of-state vehicles within thirty days of residency.

entries.reviewSummary: Authorizes the director of revenue to adjust registration periods to equalize clerical workload and issue replacement plates without fee.

headings.title: Adjustment of registration periods to balance workload
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes director to advance renewal dates and shorten periods to prevent clerical backlogs.

headings.title: Plate exchange and pro rata fee credits
headings.reviewNote: Requires notifying registrants, crediting unelapsed fees, and issuing new plates without cost.

entries.reviewSummary: Requires licensing of vehicle title service agents, prescribes annual applications, fees, background standards, and expiration dates.

headings.title: Licensing required for title service agents
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits conducting business as fee-based title service agent without department of revenue license.

headings.title: Annual license application and fifty-dollar fee
headings.reviewNote: Requires annual sworn application by July first detailing business address, officers, and fifty-dollar fee.

headings.title: Department investigation and annual license issuance
headings.reviewNote: Directs department to verify moral character and statutory compliance before issuing annual license.

entries.reviewSummary: Mandates three-year recordkeeping for licensed vehicle title service agents and requires records open to law enforcement inspection.

headings.title: Title service agent records required
headings.reviewNote: Requires title service licensees to maintain vehicle application, owner, identification, and odometer records for three years.

headings.title: Inspection of title service records
headings.reviewNote: Makes required title service records open to inspection by department representatives, highway patrol, and peace officers.

entries.reviewSummary: Requires twenty-five thousand dollar surety bonds for title service agents, specifies indemnity terms, and limits aggregate liability.

headings.title: Surety bond requirement for title service agents
headings.reviewNote: Requires twenty-five thousand dollar corporate surety bond conditioned on faithful performance of vehicle titling duties.

headings.title: Indemnity scope and court judgment payout
headings.reviewNote: Provides indemnity for losses caused by licensee misconduct and requires final court judgments for bond disbursement.

entries.reviewSummary: Prescribes statutory grounds for suspending or revoking title service agent licenses and establishes class A misdemeanor penalties.

headings.title: Grounds for license suspension or revocation
headings.reviewNote: Requires suspension or revocation upon notice and hearing opportunity for fraud, titling noncompliance, or failure to display license prominently.

headings.title: Class A misdemeanor penalty for violations
headings.reviewNote: Classifies violation of vehicle title service agent statutory provisions as a class A misdemeanor.

entries.reviewSummary: Authorizes quarterly prorated refunds or credits upon surrender of heavy commercial license plates, including reciprocal agreements.

headings.title: Prorated refund upon surrender of commercial plates
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes quarterly prorated refunds or credits for commercial vehicles over fifty-four thousand pounds.

headings.title: Prorated refunds under interstate reciprocity agreements
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes commercial registration refunds from other states under reciprocity compacts upon receipt of returned funds.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs motor vehicle license plate issuance, design, reflective materials, display rules, validation tabs, and administrative rulemaking.

headings.title: Issuance of license plates and registration certificate
headings.reviewNote: Directs department to issue registration certificate and two license plates or one plate for trailers.

headings.title: Uniform plate numbering and distinguishing marks
headings.reviewNote: Requires uniform letter and number arrangements within each registration class and authorizes grouping and distinguishing marks.

headings.title: Single-plate vehicle classes and optional second plate
headings.reviewNote: Issues one plate for heavy commercial vehicles, buses, trailers, motorcycles, autocycles, and driveaways, allowing a second plate for >12,000-pound commercial vehicles for an extra fee.

headings.title: Manufacturer, dealer, and commercial plate markings
headings.reviewNote: Applies section 301.560 markings to manufacturer and dealer plates and authorizes distinguishing letters or marks for commercial vehicles and trailers.

headings.title: Secure license plate attachment and placement
headings.reviewNote: Requires clean, unobstructed, securely fastened plates positioned by vehicle type, permitting transparent covers that do not impair visibility or reflectivity.

headings.title: Issuance and display of annual validation tabs
headings.reviewNote: Provides annual or biennial validation tabs, a six-year plate issuance cycle, and permanent nonexpiring plates with return or transfer rules for section 301.041 commercial vehicles.

headings.title: Rulemaking authority for plate administration
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the director of revenue and highways and transportation commission to prescribe rules pursuant to section 536.024.

headings.title: Eligibility for special personalized license plates
headings.reviewNote: Permits owners of motor vehicles (excluding apportioned and >24,000-pound commercial vehicles) to apply for special personalized plates, including on and after August 28, 2016.

headings.title: License plate reissuance and exemptions
headings.reviewNote: Requires commencing plate reissuance by January 1, 2019, under section 301.125 design with applicant plate-cost fees, exempting historic, specialized, permanent commercial, and sections 301.073/301.443 plates.

entries.reviewSummary: Authorizes historic motor vehicle registrations, 1,000-mile personal driving allowances, mileage logs, and historic plate displays.

headings.title: Permanent registration of historic motor vehicles
headings.reviewNote: Requires permanent registration for collector vehicles over twenty-five years old used for exhibition and education for twenty-five dollars, cancelling and requiring plate return upon title transfer.

headings.title: Application and certificate of registration
headings.reviewNote: Requires owners to file an application on a director-prescribed form for a registration certificate that need not specify horsepower.

headings.title: Issuance of reflective historic license plates
headings.reviewNote: Directs issuance of reflective historic license plates matching regular annual registration counts and section 301.130 standards.

headings.title: Mileage limits, personal-use log, and revocation
headings.reviewNote: Allows driving 100 miles to repair facilities and 1,000 personal miles yearly (excluding antique tours) with an in-vehicle log, imposing section 301.440 penalties and plate revocation.

headings.title: Display of historic year of manufacture plates
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes displaying authentic Missouri license plates corresponding to vehicle year of manufacture.

entries.reviewSummary: Regulates street rods and custom vehicles, safety certifications, replica titles, inspection exemptions, and blue dot tail lights.

headings.title: Street rod defined
headings.reviewNote: Defines street rod as an altered pre-1949 vehicle or post-1948 vehicle made to resemble a pre-1949 model.

headings.title: Model year designation and replica title
headings.reviewNote: Requires custom street rods to list model year resembled and title designated as replica.

headings.title: Personalized plate fee for street rods
headings.reviewNote: Imposes annual fee equal to personalized plate charges for street rod registrations.

headings.title: Certification of occasional vehicle usage
headings.reviewNote: Requires owner certification that vehicle is maintained for occasional exhibition, parades, and hobby use.

headings.title: Safety inspection requirement for street rods
headings.reviewNote: Mandates safety inspection approved by public safety in consultation with street rod community.

headings.title: Issuance and display of street rod plates
headings.reviewNote: Directs issuance of two distinctive reflective plates bearing the words 'STREET ROD'.

headings.title: Original equipment statute requirement
headings.reviewNote: Exempts street rods from modern equipment mandates not required by statute during manufacture year.

headings.title: Exemption from emissions and periodic inspection
headings.reviewNote: Exempts registered street rods from periodic vehicle safety and emission inspection requirements.

headings.title: Custom vehicle defined
headings.reviewNote: Defines custom vehicle as altered post-1948 vehicle at least twenty-five years old resembling older models.

headings.title: Replica title designation for custom vehicles
headings.reviewNote: Requires custom vehicle titles to list resembled year and be designated with word 'REPLICA'.

headings.title: Annual fee for custom vehicle registration
headings.reviewNote: Imposes annual personalized plate fee in addition to regular registration charges for custom vehicles.

headings.title: Certification of occasional custom vehicle use
headings.reviewNote: Requires certification that custom vehicle is maintained for occasional hobby and club transportation.

headings.title: Safety inspection requirement for custom vehicles
headings.reviewNote: Requires custom vehicles to pass initial safety inspection developed with street rod community.

headings.title: Issuance and display of custom vehicle plates
headings.reviewNote: Directs issuance of two distinctive reflective plates bearing the words 'CUSTOM VEHICLE'.

headings.title: Specific equipment conditions for custom vehicles
headings.reviewNote: Excludes equipment mandates not required by Missouri statutes during listed manufacture year.

headings.title: Inspection exemption for registered custom vehicles
headings.reviewNote: Exempts custom vehicles from periodic safety and emission control inspection mandates.

headings.title: Blue dot tail light defined
headings.reviewNote: Defines blue dot tail light as a rear red lamp with a blue or purple insert not more than one inch in diameter.

headings.title: Authorized use of blue dot tail lights
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes street rods and custom vehicles to use blue dot tail lights for stop and turn signals.

entries.reviewSummary: Exempts special mobile equipment from titling and registration on highways and authorizes unrestricted highway travel for qualified units.

headings.title: Registration exemption for special mobile equipment
headings.reviewNote: Permits moving special mobile equipment between job sites without titling or plates, restricting weekend travel.

headings.title: Highway travel authorization for high-speed equipment
headings.reviewNote: Permits unrestricted operation of special mobile equipment meeting highway speeds and weight limits.

entries.reviewSummary: Authorizes Daughters of the American Revolution special license plates, emblem contributions, fees, and administrative rulemaking.

headings.title: Special license plates for Daughters of American Revolution
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes DAR members to apply for specialty license plates bearing organization emblem.

headings.title: Emblem-use contribution and authorization statement
headings.reviewNote: Requires twenty-five dollar emblem donation to state society to obtain authorization statement.

headings.title: Issuance of personalized reflective DAR plates
headings.reviewNote: Directs department to issue reflective DAR specialty plates upon payment of fifteen-dollar fee.

headings.title: Administrative rulemaking compliance procedures
headings.reviewNote: Conditions validity of administrative rules on compliance with chapter 536 administrative procedures.

entries.reviewSummary: Authorizes permanent registration of vintage camping or fifth-wheel trailers over twenty-five years old and historic plate displays.

headings.title: Permanent registration of vintage trailers
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes permanent registration of camping trailers over twenty-five years old for fifty-two fifty fee.

headings.title: Application and certificate of registration
headings.reviewNote: Requires the trailer owner to file an application on a director-prescribed form for issuance of a registration certificate.

headings.title: Registration of year-of-manufacture historic plates
headings.reviewNote: Permits registering authentic Missouri plates over twenty-five years old matching the trailer's manufacture year, exempting them from section 301.130 reflective standards and requiring the certificate in the trailer.

entries.reviewSummary: Authorizes wheelchair users and transporters with disabled plates or placards to purchase accessible parking cones and directs department rulemaking.

headings.title: Wheelchair parking cones for disabled placard holders
headings.reviewNote: Requires the director to allow disabled plate or placard holders who use or transport wheelchair users to purchase orange or fluorescent parking cones at least eighteen inches tall.

headings.title: Rulemaking authority under chapter 536
headings.reviewNote: Directs the director of revenue to promulgate administrative rules to administer parking cones in compliance with chapter 536.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs plate transfers upon vehicle sale, thirty-day transfer periods, temporary permits, dealer issuance, and salvage vehicle permits.

headings.title: Removal of plates upon sale or transfer
headings.reviewNote: Requires seller to remove license plates upon vehicle transfer and allows transfer to new vehicle.

headings.title: Payment of difference in registration fees
headings.reviewNote: Requires paying pro rata registration fee difference when transferring plates to higher fee vehicle.

headings.title: Plate transfer from inactive to newly purchased vehicle
headings.reviewNote: Allows transferring plates from a vehicle no longer operated to a newly purchased vehicle for a two-dollar fee plus pro rata difference for higher classes, with no refund for lower classes.

headings.title: Issuance and fee for temporary registration permits
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes issuing temporary permits for five-dollar fee valid for thirty days pending registration.

headings.title: Temporary permit restrictions, destruction, and extension
headings.reviewNote: Limits temporary permits to the purchased vehicle, bars transfer or renewal, requires destruction upon plate issuance, exempts >24,000-pound commercial vehicles, and allows director reissuance.

headings.title: Dealer temporary permit records and police access
headings.reviewNote: Requires dealers to maintain temporary permit records for inspection and directs the director to make issued permit information immediately available to Missouri law enforcement.

headings.title: Registration fee credit on category change
headings.reviewNote: Allows owners unable to transfer plates due to a vehicle category change to surrender plates for a pro rata credit toward another vehicle, with no refunds.

headings.title: Third temporary plate for obstructed rear view
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes purchasing third interior window plate when bicycle racks or cargo obstruct rear plate.

headings.title: Temporary permit for salvage vehicle inspection
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes temporary permit to operate salvage vehicle directly to safety inspection facility.

headings.title: Administrative rulemaking compliance procedures
headings.reviewNote: Conditions validity of administrative rules on compliance with chapter 536 statutory rulemaking procedures.

headings.title: Effective date of temporary permit provisions
headings.reviewNote: Establishes contingent effective date upon temporary permit production or July 1, 2013, whichever occurs first; revisor's note records effective date of July 1, 2013.

entries.reviewSummary: Classifies fraudulent procurement of disabled license plates as a class B misdemeanor and penalizes false health practitioner certifications.

headings.title: Class B misdemeanor for fraudulent disabled plates
headings.reviewNote: Classifies fraudulent procurement or unauthorized use of disabled plates or placards as class B misdemeanor.

headings.title: Penalties for false physician disability statements
headings.reviewNote: Classifies signing false disability certifications outside practitioner scope as class B misdemeanor.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes comprehensive criteria for disabled license plates and windshield placards, physician statements, renewals, and fraud penalties.

headings.title: Definitions for disabled parking privileges
headings.reviewNote: Defines department, director, health care practitioner, physically disabled, and windshield placards.

headings.title: Authorized scope for health care practitioners
headings.reviewNote: Restricts practitioner disability statements to physical conditions legally within practitioner scope.

headings.title: Required contents of physician statement
headings.reviewNote: Mandates state form, medical diagnosis, practitioner license number, and personal signature.

headings.title: Permanent or temporary disability designation
headings.reviewNote: Requires designating disability as permanent or temporary with duration capped at 180 days.

headings.title: Medical chart documentation by issuing practitioner
headings.reviewNote: Requires issuing physicians and practitioners to record the certificate issuance, date, qualifying diagnosis, and objective confirmation in the patient's medical chart.

headings.title: Licensing board inspection of medical records
headings.reviewNote: Opens practitioner disability certification records to inspection by the practitioner's licensing board while maintaining confidentiality except for prosecution, discipline, or legal disclosure.

headings.title: Eligibility and issuance of disabled plates
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes issuing disabled plates to qualified individuals, parents, guardians, and organizations.

headings.title: Issuance of windshield placards with disabled plates
headings.reviewNote: Directs issuance upon request of one, or up to two for good cause, removable disabled windshield hanging placards to disabled-plate applicants.

headings.title: No additional fee for disabled plates
headings.reviewNote: Exempts disabled license plates from additional specialty fees beyond standard registration charges.

headings.title: Eligibility for removable windshield placards
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes issuing removable hanging placards to disabled persons, guardians, and transit entities.

headings.title: Conformity of placards to federal standards
headings.reviewNote: Requires removable windshield placards to conform to federal specifications for size, color, and design.

headings.title: Issuance of temporary windshield placards
headings.reviewNote: Directs issuance of temporary placards valid for up to 180 days based on physician statement.

headings.title: Placard renewals restricted to original holder
headings.reviewNote: Restricts placard renewals to original recipients and prohibits transferring placards to others.

headings.title: Issuance of disabled registration certificate
headings.reviewNote: Requires issuing a registration certificate listing applicant or agency name, address, and plate or placard number, with the validated receipt serving as the certificate.

headings.title: Information on disabled parking rights provided
headings.reviewNote: Directs department to distribute informational brochures explaining disabled parking statutory rights.

headings.title: Verification of disability and age exemptions
headings.reviewNote: Mandates physician proof every eight years, exempting disabled veterans and individuals over seventy-five.

headings.title: Verification of health practitioner licensure
headings.reviewNote: Directs director to verify medical licenses with state healing arts and professional licensing boards.

headings.title: Cooperation by professional licensing boards
headings.reviewNote: Directs licensing boards to furnish practitioner rosters and cooperate in verifying medical credentials.

headings.title: Perjury penalty for false transport statement
headings.reviewNote: Requires joint affidavit for vehicles used to transport disabled persons, subject to perjury penalties.

headings.title: Department retention of disability records
headings.reviewNote: Requires department of revenue to retain all physician statements and disability documents on file.

headings.title: Reciprocity agreements for disabled placards
headings.reviewNote: Directs the director of revenue to enter into reciprocity agreements with other states or the federal government recognizing disabled plates and placards.

headings.title: Mandatory surrender of plates upon death
headings.reviewNote: Requires decedent's representative to return disabled plates and placards under class B misdemeanor penalty.

headings.title: Authority to order medical reexamination
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes director to order medical examinations to determine ongoing eligibility for disabled privileges.

headings.title: Confiscation of plates upon disqualification
headings.reviewNote: Directs department to confiscate disabled plates and issue standard replacements if holder is disqualified.

headings.title: Application and fee for lost placards
headings.reviewNote: Requires affidavit within five days and four-dollar fee to replace lost, stolen, or damaged placards.

headings.title: Class A and class B misdemeanor penalties
headings.reviewNote: Classifies fraudulent application as class A misdemeanor and practitioner miscertification as class B misdemeanor.

entries.reviewSummary: Regulates parking spaces reserved for physically disabled persons, requires signage, restricts parking, and establishes fines.

headings.title: Definitions for disabled parking provisions
headings.reviewNote: Incorporates the statutory definitions of vehicle from section 301.010 and physically disabled from section 301.142.

headings.title: Designation of disabled spaces, signage, and van aisles
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes local and requires private public-parking designation of disabled spaces with accessibility and fine signs, plus ninety-six-inch lift-van access aisles starting August 28, 2011.

headings.title: Entrance proximity and adjacent space signage
headings.reviewNote: Permits political subdivisions and private parking operators to designate reserved spaces closest to accessible entrances with adjacent accessibility signs.

headings.title: Vehicle removal, infraction fine, and abandonment
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes police or sheriff removal of unauthorized vehicles from signed disabled spaces, sets a $50 to $300 infraction fine, and deems unclaimed vehicles abandoned after thirty days.

headings.title: Federal ADA compliance and residential blue curbs
headings.reviewNote: Requires designated spaces to meet federal ADA standards and mandates painted accessibility symbols and blue curbs for residential on-street spaces.

headings.title: Class B misdemeanor for unauthorized placard use
headings.reviewNote: Classifies unauthorized use of a disabled license plate or card to park in a reserved space as a class B misdemeanor.

headings.title: Law enforcement entry onto private parking areas
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes law enforcement officials to enter private property open to public use to enforce sections 301.143 and 301.142.

headings.title: Grandfathering of pre-2011 nonconforming signs and spaces
headings.reviewNote: Exempts nonconforming signs or spaces in use before August 28, 2011, during their normal useful life.

headings.title: Prohibition on handicap wording on new signs
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits new signs erected beginning August 28, 2011, from containing the words 'Handicap Parking' or 'Handicapped Parking'.

entries.reviewSummary: Authorizes personalized license plates, fees, configuration criteria, military exemptions, and plate reissue.

headings.title: Personalized license plates authorized
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes vehicle owners to obtain personalized license plates bearing custom letter configurations.

headings.title: Temporary permit pending personalized plate issuance
headings.reviewNote: Directs the director to issue a temporary operating permit to personalized plate applicants who have no registration plate available for transfer.

headings.title: Prohibited obscene or offensive plate combinations
headings.reviewNote: Bars obscene, profane, offensive, or dangerous combinations, permits recall with free reissue, preserves constitutional limits and collector use, and states plates are not a public forum.

headings.title: Categories of personalized special license plates
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the director to establish categories of special license plates subject to the same application and additional fee, unless exempted under subsection 7.

headings.title: Amateur radio operator special license plates
headings.reviewNote: Directs issuance of personalized plates bearing FCC call letters and 'AMATEUR RADIO' to licensed amateur radio operators, with replacement rules.

headings.title: Demonstration placards for repossessed vehicles
headings.reviewNote: Directs issuance of numbered 'Repossessed' demonstration placards to repossession businesses paying dealer license fees under section 301.560.

headings.title: Personalized plate fee exemption for military retirees
headings.reviewNote: Exempts military retirees with twenty years of honorable service from personalized plate fees.

entries.reviewSummary: Authorizes confidential special license plates and driver licenses for law enforcement and public safety agencies.

headings.title: Special license plates for law enforcement agencies
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes director to issue special plates and driver licenses for legitimate investigative purposes.

headings.title: Confidentiality of undercover vehicle records
headings.reviewNote: Exempts undercover law enforcement vehicle records from public disclosure and open records laws.

entries.reviewSummary: Authorizes optional biennial motor vehicle registrations, model-year renewal schedules, inspection requirements, and rulemaking.

headings.title: Optional biennial vehicle registration authorized
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes two-year registrations based on odd or even model years with pro rata fees.

headings.title: Administrative rulemaking compliance procedures
headings.reviewNote: Conditions validity of administrative rules on compliance with chapter 536 administrative procedures.

headings.title: Staggering of biennial registration periods
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes director to stagger biennial registration periods and mandates maintaining full two-year cycle.

entries.reviewSummary: Authorizes displaying electronic proof of vehicle insurance on mobile devices, limits state agent liability, and restricts viewing.

headings.title: Electronic proof of insurance authorized on mobile device
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes displaying electronic image of insurance card on mobile device for registration.

headings.title: Owner assumes liability for device damage
headings.reviewNote: Places liability for mobile device damage during presentation on person presenting device, exempting willful harm.

headings.title: Agent restricted to viewing insurance proof
headings.reviewNote: Restricts revenue employees and fee agents to viewing only insurance proof on mobile device.

headings.title: Mobile electronic device defined
headings.reviewNote: Defines mobile electronic device as handheld computing or communications equipment with display screen.

entries.reviewSummary: Requires plate removal upon vehicle transfer, allows retention for future registrations, and prohibits attaching voided plates.

headings.title: Removal and retention of license plates
headings.reviewNote: Requires removing license plates upon sale or transfer and allows retaining plates for future registrations.

headings.title: One-year expiration of retained license plates
headings.reviewNote: Voids retained plates not reassigned to another vehicle within one year and authorizes reissue.

headings.title: Attaching voided license plates prohibited
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits fastening voided license plates to motor vehicles under general misdemeanor penalties.

entries.reviewSummary: Authorizes maintenance trip permits for empty local commercial vehicles traveling beyond zones, fees, and utility emergency exemptions.

headings.title: Maintenance trip permit issuance and fee
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes five-dollar trip permit for empty commercial vehicles traveling beyond twenty-five miles for repairs.

headings.title: Travel authorization beyond commercial license zone
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes operation of empty local commercial vehicle beyond twenty-five mile zone under permit.

headings.title: Maintenance trip permit defined
headings.reviewNote: Defines maintenance trip permit as supplemental permit solely for travel to repair facilities.

headings.title: Permit fees credited to state highway fund
headings.reviewNote: Directs all trip permit fees collected by department to be deposited in state highway fund.

headings.title: Utility emergency exemption beyond zone
headings.reviewNote: Permits commercial vehicles assisting electric, gas, or water utility emergencies to operate beyond zone.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs certificate of ownership applications, fees, physical examinations, salvage titling, liens, and title transfers.

headings.title: Certificate of ownership application and timing
headings.reviewNote: Requires title application within thirty days of acquisition (or dealer title receipt under sections 301.213 or 301.210(5)), listing odometer, source of title, liens, and lienholder approval for name changes.

headings.title: Director verification of title application
headings.reviewNote: Directs director to verify application genuineness, lien validity, and check stolen vehicle records.

headings.title: Special title brands and duplicate mileage notations
headings.reviewNote: Requires reconstructed, motor-change, specially constructed, and non-USA-std title brands, annual odometer update notices effective July 1, 1990, and recent mileage reprinting on duplicate titles.

headings.title: Counterfeit-resistant certificate of ownership standards
headings.reviewNote: Requires manufacturing certificates to deter alteration or counterfeiting and authorizes contracting with a nonprofit scientific or educational institution for secure-document analysis.

headings.title: Title fee, delinquency penalties, and lifetime validity
headings.reviewNote: Sets an $8.50 title fee, $25-per-30-day delinquency penalty up to $200 (waivable for good cause), registration cancellation for failure to title, and lifetime certificate validity.

headings.title: Additional fee for expedited title processing
headings.reviewNote: Imposes an additional five-dollar fee for applicants requesting expeditious special handling of a certificate of ownership application.

headings.title: Operating vehicle without title application prohibited
headings.reviewNote: Makes it unlawful to operate a motor vehicle or trailer required to be registered unless a certificate of ownership has been applied for.

headings.title: Inspection of out-of-state titles with Missouri salvage history
headings.reviewNote: Requires Missouri state highway patrol inspection and VIN verification ($25 fee, waived with comparable out-of-state police inspection) for out-of-state titled vehicles with prior Missouri salvage titles.

headings.title: Physical vehicle examination requirement
headings.reviewNote: Requires physical examination by highway patrol or authorized agency for salvage or non-USA vehicles.

headings.title: Inspection of out-of-state titled vehicles
headings.reviewNote: Requires an official inspection station VIN and odometer verification for vehicles previously titled or registered out of state or under section 301.020, excluding manufacturer's statement of origin transfers.

headings.title: Highway patrol inspection for wrecked or towed imports
headings.reviewNote: Requires subsection 9 highway patrol inspection for wrecked, damaged, or out-of-state abandoned vehicles brought into Missouri and mandates carrying forward salvage or junk designations.

headings.title: Carrying forward out-of-state salvage and rebuilt brands
headings.reviewNote: Requires carrying forward out-of-state reconstructed, motor-change, specially constructed, or prior-salvage brands with issuing state name and protects due-diligence transferors from missing-brand liability.

headings.title: Carrying forward out-of-state non-USA-standard brand
headings.reviewNote: Requires carrying forward the 'Non-USA-Std Motor Vehicle' designation on current and subsequent Missouri certificates for vehicles so branded by another state.

headings.title: Joint inspection rulemaking authority
headings.reviewNote: Directs the director of revenue and the superintendent of the Missouri state highway patrol to make and enforce rules administering inspections under this section.

headings.title: Titling forty-year-old low-value reconstructed vehicles
headings.reviewNote: Sets alternative affidavit, parts-receipt, $150 fee, and law-enforcement stolen-vehicle inspection requirements for reconstructed vehicles forty or more years old valued at $3,000 or less.

entries.reviewSummary: Prescribes sheriff and highway patrol inspection procedures for homemade trailers, identification number stamping, and seizure of stolen units.

headings.title: Inspection application for homemade trailers
headings.reviewNote: Requires owner of homemade trailer to apply to county sheriff or highway patrol for inspection.

headings.title: Homemade trailer defined
headings.reviewNote: Defines homemade as made by a person who is not a manufacturer using readily distinguishable manufacturers' identifying numbers or a statement of origin.

headings.title: Required sheriff or highway patrol inspection
headings.reviewNote: Requires homemade trailer builders to obtain a sheriff or highway patrol inspection before titling and to transfer the inspection certificate if sold beforehand.

headings.title: Twenty-five dollar inspection fee and fund deposits
headings.reviewNote: Sets a twenty-five dollar inspection fee deposited into the county law enforcement or general revenue fund for sheriff inspections, or the state highway fund for highway patrol inspections.

headings.title: Inspection certification and tongue number stamping
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes officers to certify homemade trailers and stamp permanent numbers into tongue frame.

headings.title: Issuance and affixing of manufacturer ID plate
headings.reviewNote: Directs department to issue metal identification plate to be affixed to trailer tongue frame.

headings.title: Seizure of stolen trailers or defaced numbers
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes law enforcement seizure and investigative retention of stolen or defaced trailers.

entries.reviewSummary: Authorizes bonded certificates of ownership for vehicles seven years old or older with valuation under three thousand dollars.

headings.title: Bonded title application for older vehicles
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes bonded title for older low-value vehicles with affidavit, inspection, and two-times-value bond.

headings.title: Issuance of bonded vehicle title
headings.reviewNote: Directs department to issue new certificate designated with the words 'BONDED VEHICLE'.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs titling of abandoned vehicles on private real estate, insurance claims adjustment salvage titles, and dealer abandoned titles.

headings.title: Application for title to abandoned vehicle
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes landowner or insurer to apply for title after law enforcement check and thirty-day notice.

headings.title: Title issuance and owner protest procedure
headings.reviewNote: Prescribes department record search, thirty-day protest window, and original or salvage title issuance.

headings.title: Insurer salvage title through claims adjustment
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes insurers to obtain salvage or junking certificate when negotiable title is unavailable.

headings.title: Salvage pool abandoned vehicle titling
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes licensed salvage pools and dismantlers to obtain salvage titles for abandoned vehicles.

headings.title: Used motor vehicle dealer abandoned titling
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes licensed used car dealers to obtain salvage titles for abandoned vehicles after notice.

headings.title: Watercraft claims adjustment title procedure
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes insurers purchasing Missouri-titled vessels or watercraft through claims adjustment without negotiable title to apply for a certificate of title after thirty-day notice.

entries.reviewSummary: Requires motor vehicle and trailer transferors to submit a notice of transfer to the department of revenue within thirty days and specifies exemptions.

headings.title: Transferor notice of sale required within thirty days
headings.reviewNote: Requires transferors of Missouri-titled vehicles or trailers (excluding salvage and junking titles) to notify the department within thirty days beginning January 1, 2006, listing ten required elements.

headings.title: Effectiveness of substantially compliant notice
headings.reviewNote: Provides that a notice of sale substantially complying with this section remains effective despite minor errors that are not materially misleading.

headings.title: Transfers by operation of law and repossession exception
headings.reviewNote: Designates personal representatives, receivers, trustees, sheriffs, or successors as transferors for operation-of-law transfers and excludes creditor repossessions.

headings.title: Exempt transfers of ownership interest
headings.reviewNote: Exempts incomplete ownership changes, court-ordered awards, dealer transfers, theft or casualty insurer transfers, and trust beneficial ownership transfers.

headings.title: Informational scope of transfer notification
headings.reviewNote: Limits notice to transfers requiring Missouri registration and title under section 301.190 and specifies the notice is informational only, not an assignment or release.

headings.title: Licensed dealer retail sales reporting
headings.reviewNote: Directs that retail sales by licensed dealers, including new vehicles, be reported under section 301.280.

entries.reviewSummary: Directs the department of revenue to record transfer notifications, notify transferees who fail to apply for title within sixty days, and adopt implementing rules.

headings.title: Department record notation of transfer notice
headings.reviewNote: Requires the department, beginning January 1, 2006, to note received transfer notices on its records and disclose the notice and transferee name alongside record owner and lienholder data.

headings.title: Sixty-day notice to transferee to apply for title
headings.reviewNote: Requires the department to notify the named transferee to apply for title if no title application is received within sixty days after receipt of the transfer notice.

headings.title: Rulemaking authority and highway fund appropriations
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes chapter 536 rulemaking (nonseverable, post-August 28, 2004) and permits appropriating state highways and transportation department funds for sections 301.196 to 301.198 and 301.280.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes criminal and infraction penalties for knowingly submitting false vehicle transfer notices or failing to submit required transfer notifications.

headings.title: Class C misdemeanor for false transfer notice
headings.reviewNote: Classifies knowingly submitting false information in a section 301.196 notice of vehicle transfer beginning January 1, 2006, as a class C misdemeanor.

headings.title: Infraction and misdemeanor for omitted transfer notice
headings.reviewNote: Classifies failing to submit a required section 301.196 notice as an infraction, or a class C misdemeanor if done to assist avoiding title, fees, or for fraud.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes dealer certificate of ownership requirements for inventory, manufacturer's statement of origin delivery for new cars, and four-assignment title spaces.

headings.title: Dealer certificate of ownership requirements for inventory
headings.reviewNote: Requires dealers to hold a certificate of ownership or proof of application or lien satisfaction for each vehicle in possession, excluding new vehicles or trailers sold by manufacturers to dealers.

headings.title: Manufacturer's statement of origin for new car sales
headings.reviewNote: Requires dealers to execute and deliver manufacturer's statements of origin on director-prescribed forms for new cars sold, supporting certificate of ownership issuance.

headings.title: Four assignment spaces and secure dealer assignment forms
headings.reviewNote: Requires four assignment spaces on titles, directs a secure form for fourth dealer assignments when fewer exist, and mandates monthly return of voided spoiled forms.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs mandatory title assignments upon vehicle sales, delayed title delivery agreements, dealer bonds, and void sales.

headings.title: Mandatory assignment of title upon vehicle sale
headings.reviewNote: Requires seller to execute title assignment with warranty of title and buyer to apply for new title.

headings.title: Buyer presentation of assigned title for registration
headings.reviewNote: Requires the buyer to present the assigned certificate at registration to obtain a new certificate of ownership upon paying the section 301.190(5) fee.

headings.title: Notice of nonresident sales or destroyed vehicles
headings.reviewNote: Requires immediate notice to the director when a vehicle or trailer is sold to a nonresident or destroyed or dismantled, and directs retention and indexing of returned certificates.

headings.title: Sales without title assignment fraudulent and void
headings.reviewNote: Declares vehicle sales without contemporary title assignment fraudulent and void, subject to delayed pacts.

headings.title: Delayed title delivery agreement for licensed dealers
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes bonded dealers to deliver vehicles with thirty-day delayed title agreement and bond.

entries.reviewSummary: Authorizes bonded dealers to purchase, trade, and sell vehicles subject to existing liens, sets title delivery timelines, civil remedies, license sanctions, and a December 31, 2020 repeal date.

headings.title: Dealer trade of vehicles subject to liens
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes bonded dealers to accept vehicles subject to liens under written contract and power of attorney.

headings.title: Finality of trade and cessation of insurable interest
headings.reviewNote: Deems trade final and terminates prior owner insurable interest upon physical vehicle delivery.

headings.title: Dealer sale prior to title receipt conditions
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes dealer sales prior to title receipt upon lien payoff, child support check, and sixty-day pact.

headings.title: Dealer deadlines for replacement title and delivery
headings.reviewNote: Requires the dealer to apply for a duplicate or replacement title within ten business days and assign and deliver it to the purchaser within five business days of receipt.

headings.title: Dealer liability for subsection 3 noncompliance
headings.reviewNote: Makes a licensed dealer who violates subsection 3 liable to a damaged purchaser for actual damages, court costs, and reasonable attorney fees.

headings.title: Purchaser direct title procedure upon dealer default
headings.reviewNote: Makes dealers liable for subsection 4 violations and allows purchasers to apply directly to the director for title cancellation and reissuance after a ten-business-day dealer objection period.

headings.title: Seller liability for ownership misrepresentation
headings.reviewNote: Makes a seller who misrepresents vehicle ownership to a dealer liable to damaged parties for actual and punitive damages, court costs, and reasonable attorney fees.

headings.title: Dealer liability for lienholder damages
headings.reviewNote: Makes a licensed dealer liable to a damaged lienholder for actual damages, court costs, and reasonable attorney fees arising from acts, errors, omissions, or violations.

headings.title: Thirty-day written demand prerequisite for fees
headings.reviewNote: Bars awarding court costs or attorney fees unless the aggrieved party delivered an itemized written demand for actual damages that went unsatisfied for thirty days.

headings.title: Suspension of dealer delayed titling privileges
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes director to suspend dealer delayed title privileges for statutory noncompliance.

headings.title: December 31, 2020 contract cutoff and repeal
headings.reviewNote: Bars entering contracts under this section after December 31, 2020, preserves prior contracts, and repeals the section effective December 31, 2020.

entries.reviewSummary: Authorizes issuance of repossession certificates of ownership to lienholders upon vehicle default, affidavits, and notice.

headings.title: Repossession certificate of ownership authorized
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes issuing repossession title to lienholder upon vehicle default and physical repossession.

headings.title: Ten-day prior notice to owners and lienholders
headings.reviewNote: Requires the lienholder to send ten days' written first-class mail notice to owners and other lienholders, or include the notice in a compliant UCC notice under sections 400.9-613 or 400.9-614.

headings.title: Issuance of repossessed title for ten-dollar fee
headings.reviewNote: Directs the director, upon receiving required papers and a ten-dollar fee, to issue a 'Repossessed Title' superseding and voiding any outstanding title or duplicates.

headings.title: Repossessed title when no debtor title exists
headings.reviewNote: Directs issuing a repossessed title when no certificate is outstanding in the debtor's name and collecting unpaid fees, taxes, charges, and penalties from the debtor under section 301.190.

headings.title: Rulemaking authority under chapter 536
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes director rulemaking subject to chapter 536 nonseverability provisions for rules proposed or adopted after August 28, 2005.

entries.reviewSummary: Defines key salvage terms for sections 301.217 to 301.229 and authorizes bonded certificates of title for salvaged motor vehicles at least twenty-five years old.

headings.title: Definitions for salvage vehicle provisions
headings.reviewNote: Defines purchaser, salvage certificate of title (not acceptable for registration, one reassignment by dealers or insurers), and salvage pool or salvage disposal sale.

headings.title: Title and optional bond for older salvage vehicles
headings.reviewNote: Permits issuing a certificate of title for salvaged motor vehicles at least twenty-five years old and requiring a three-year corporate surety bond of one and one-half times vehicle value.

entries.reviewSummary: Requires licensing for used parts dealers, salvage dealers, rebuilders, and scrap processors, regulates salvage pool buyers and records, and mandates export title stamping.

headings.title: Licensing required for salvage dealers and dismantlers
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits operating salvage pool, dismantler, or rebuild business without department license.

headings.title: Eligible salvage pool buyers and quarterly records
headings.reviewNote: Limits salvage pool sales to licensed dealers, authorized out-of-state buyers, and foreign export buyers, requiring three-year sales records open for inspection and submitted quarterly.

headings.title: Export stamping on titles sold to non-U.S. residents
headings.reviewNote: Requires stamping 'FOR EXPORT ONLY' at least two inches wide on the face and unused reassignment spaces of titles sold to non-U.S. residents and forwarding copies to the department.

headings.title: Separate license designations by business type
headings.reviewNote: Directs the director of revenue to issue separate licenses designated as used parts dealer, salvage dealer or dismantler, rebuilder or body shop, or scrap processor.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes salvage business license approval criteria, law enforcement site certification, bona fide place of business requirements, and initial premises photographs.

headings.title: License issuance upon character and compliance review
headings.reviewNote: Directs the department to file applications and issue licenses until the next renewal date when satisfied of the applicant's good moral character and compliance with salvage and titling laws.

headings.title: Law enforcement certification and enclosed business premises
headings.reviewNote: Requires highway patrol or metropolitan police certification for salvage dealer applicants and a bona fide permanent enclosed building occupied for the licensed business.

headings.title: Public contact access and on-site recordkeeping
headings.reviewNote: Requires the place of business to allow public contact in person or by telephone at reasonable times and to house required books, records, tools, and equipment.

headings.title: Initial application photograph of business premises
headings.reviewNote: Requires an initial application photograph up to eight by ten inches showing the building and premises, waived on renewal absent substantial changes.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs salvage certificates of title, scrap metal purchases, junking certificates, theft recoveries, and 10-year-old vehicle sales.

headings.title: Mandatory and optional salvage title applications
headings.reviewNote: Requires ten-day filing and $8.50 fee for salvage titles (mandatory for vehicles up to six years past model year, optional if older) and ten-day forwarding of titles for vehicles sold for destruction.

headings.title: Issuance of negotiable junking certificates
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes negotiable junking certificates for junk vehicles and for twenty-six-year-old vehicles with a bill of sale and highway patrol non-stolen verification.

headings.title: Out-of-state junk status, rescission, and buyer disclosure
headings.reviewNote: Limits out-of-state junk vehicles to junking certificates only, allows ninety-day rescission to obtain a salvage title if not previously junk, and requires written buyer disclosure.

headings.title: Transfer of salvage title to scrap operator
headings.reviewNote: Governs assignment of salvage certificate upon transfer of vehicle to scrap metal operator.

headings.title: Scrap operator duty to surrender title for cancellation
headings.reviewNote: Requires scrap metal operators to surrender acquired salvage titles to department for cancellation.

headings.title: Three-year recordkeeping for scrap metal operators
headings.reviewNote: Requires scrap operators to maintain seller, license, and parts records open for inspection for three years.

headings.title: Dealer reassignment of salvage certificates
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes licensed motor vehicle dealers to negotiate one reassignment on salvage certificates.

headings.title: Negotiable salvage title for stolen vehicle claims
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes negotiable salvage title for insurance theft settlements and retitling upon recovery.

headings.title: Bill of sale purchases for older inoperable vehicles
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes scrap operators to acquire inoperable vehicles ten years old or older with bill of sale.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes class A misdemeanor penalties for salvage licensing violations and designates director and highway patrol enforcement.

headings.title: Class A misdemeanor for salvage violations
headings.reviewNote: Classifies violation of salvage dealer and dismantling provisions as a class A misdemeanor.

headings.title: Enforcement by director and highway patrol
headings.reviewNote: Directs director of revenue and highway patrol to administer forms, notices, and enforcement.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs registration of state, municipal, and political subdivision motor vehicles, official use limits, and school driver training cars.

headings.title: Official state vehicle plates and markings
headings.reviewNote: Requires state-owned vehicles to display official car plates and restricts usage to official business.

headings.title: Municipal and emergency vehicle exemptions and markings
headings.reviewNote: Exempts municipal ambulances, police, and fire vehicles while requiring distinguishing lettering and school bus plates.

headings.title: Temporary registration for school driver training vehicles
headings.reviewNote: Treats colleges and public schools as temporary owners of dealer-leased driver training vehicles.

headings.title: Political subdivision definition
headings.reviewNote: Defines political subdivision including townships, road districts, school districts, and transit compact agencies.

entries.reviewSummary: Authorizes seventy-two-hour ten-dollar trip permits for occasionally operated out-of-state commercial vehicles, exempts titling, and governs weight station issuance and advance sales.

headings.title: Trip permit issuance and seventy-two-hour limit
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes seventy-two-hour trip permits for operating unregistered commercial vehicles on highways.

headings.title: Exemption from Missouri motor vehicle title laws
headings.reviewNote: Provides that Missouri motor vehicle title requirements do not apply to vehicles operated under seventy-two-hour trip permits.

headings.title: Permit required prior to entering Missouri
headings.reviewNote: Requires owners or operators to secure a trip permit in full force and effect before entering or commencing a trip in Missouri.

headings.title: Arrest for noncompliance and weight station availability
headings.reviewNote: Subjects operators entering without a permit to arrest and requires obtaining a permit before proceeding, with permits available at official highway weight stations.

headings.title: Maximum statutory hauling weight under permit
headings.reviewNote: Provides that purchasing a ten-dollar trip permit allows the operator to haul the maximum weight allowed by statute.

headings.title: Advance sale of trip permits
headings.reviewNote: Permits selling trip permits in advance of use in quantities determined by the director of revenue.

entries.reviewSummary: Authorizes temporary hunter's permits for unladen commercial vehicles, twenty-five dollar fees, thirty-day limits, and rulemaking.

headings.title: Hunter's permit for unladen commercial vehicles
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes thirty-day temporary permit for unladen apportioned commercial vehicles seeking employment.

headings.title: Hunter's permit fee and credit to highway fund
headings.reviewNote: Establishes twenty-five dollar fee per permit and directs fee deposits to state highway fund.

headings.title: Exemption from Missouri motor vehicle title laws
headings.reviewNote: Exempts vehicles operating under a hunter's permit from Missouri motor vehicle title laws during the permit period.

headings.title: Fuel reporting and tax duties preserved
headings.reviewNote: Clarifies that this section does not alter the vehicle owner's duty to timely file fuel reports and pay Missouri fuel taxes.

headings.title: Director of revenue rulemaking authority
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the director of revenue to prescribe rules and regulations for the effective administration of hunter's permits.

entries.reviewSummary: Authorizes single seventy-two-hour combined commercial trip permits for a twenty-five dollar fee and incorporates statutory trip permit requirements.

headings.title: Combined seventy-two-hour trip permit and fee
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes a single seventy-two-hour permit covering sections 142.422, 301.265, and 390.136 for twenty-five dollars deposited in the state highway department fund, unless prepayment is waived by agreement.

headings.title: Applicability of statutory trip permit requirements
headings.reviewNote: Applies the trip permit requirements of sections 142.422, 301.265, and 390.136 to vehicle operation under this section.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes reciprocal Missouri registration exemptions for nonresident vehicle owners and authorizes operating out-of-state trailers in combination with registered motor vehicles.

headings.title: Reciprocal registration exemption for nonresident owners
headings.reviewNote: Permits nonresidents with current home-jurisdiction registration and plates to operate in Missouri without Missouri registration or fees if their jurisdiction grants substantially equivalent exemptions.

headings.title: Operation of out-of-state trailers in combination
headings.reviewNote: Permits trailers registered in any jurisdiction to be operated in combination with any motor vehicle properly registered under sections 301.271 to 301.279, unless otherwise provided by agreement.

entries.reviewSummary: Authorizes reciprocal registration exemption, fleet apportionment, and basing-point agreements, creates the reciprocity fund, and bars intrastate commercial reciprocity.

headings.title: Reciprocal exemptions, apportionment, and basing-point agreements
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes commission reciprocal agreements for fee exemptions, mileage-apportioned fleet licensing, and basing-point permits for vehicles based at out-of-state terminals.

headings.title: Possession of valid registration certificate required
headings.reviewNote: Requires reciprocity agreements to mandate that vehicle operators carry a valid registration certificate or proof of registration from the registering jurisdiction.

headings.title: Reciprocity fund creation and monthly state disbursements
