entries.reviewSummary: Specifies dealer application requirements, bona fide place of business, surety bonds, dealer plates, and seminars.

headings.title: Place of business, photo, $50,000 bond, and license fees
headings.reviewNote: Requires law-enforcement certification of a bona fide established place of business (with emergency-vehicle dealer exemption), initial premises photograph, $50,000 surety bond or irrevocable letter of credit plus garage policy and section 301.210(5) bond-release procedures, and license fees deposited into the Motor Vehicle Commission Fund.

headings.title: Eight-working-hour decision on new-business applications
headings.reviewNote: Requires the department to grant or deny a compliant new-business dealer, manufacturer, or auction license application within eight working hours of receipt.

headings.title: Initial dealer license number and reflective plate issuance
headings.reviewNote: Directs issuance of a distinctive dealer license number, one plate or certificate ($50), and two additional plates ($10.50 each) within eight working hours in lieu of individual vehicle registration, using reflective plates.

headings.title: Distinctive dealer number ranges and salvage dealer plates
headings.reviewNote: Assigns distinctive license number ranges by dealer class (D, W, WA, T, DM, A, M, RV) and allows licensed salvage dealers one additional plate per 50 annual qualified transactions upon August 1 certification. Source note: became effective December 1, 2008.

headings.title: Retention or replacement of license number on dealership sale
headings.reviewNote: Allows an approved buyer of a licensed motor vehicle dealership to retain the seller's license number or receive a new number with an equal number of plates or certificates.

headings.title: Dealer plate quantities, fees, volume caps, and proration
headings.reviewNote: Sets initial and additional plate/certificate fees ($50 / $10.50), annual volume limits (347 max for new manufacturers, 1 per 10 sales, 2 per 10 for first 50 RV sales), monthly proration (excluding renewals), auction certificates, and August 1 sales certification.

headings.title: Authorized and prohibited display of dealer plates
headings.reviewNote: Permits displaying dealer plates on manufacturer or resale inventory for test drives, service loaners, parades/events, employees/officers, and loaded demonstrations, while barring use on hired, loaned, or regular service/wrecker vehicles.

headings.title: Display of boat dealer and manufacturer certificates of number
headings.reviewNote: Permits displaying certificates of number on resale vessels and vessel trailers for test drives, employee/officer use, and exhibit transport, while barring display on motor vehicles or hired, loaned, or regular service vessels.

headings.title: Law enforcement seizure of misused dealer plates
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes law enforcement officers with probable cause of misuse under subsection 7 or 8 to seize and surrender dealer plates or certificates of number to the department.

headings.title: Prelicensing educational seminar requirement and exemptions
headings.reviewNote: Requires used motor vehicle dealer applicants to prove completion of an approved educational seminar within the past 12 months covering sections 301.550 to 301.580 and rules, with exemptions for auctions, existing dealers, new franchises, leasing agencies, and pre-August 28, 2006 licensees.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes grounds for refusal to issue or renew dealer licenses, disciplinary hearings, and appeals.

headings.title: Department authority to deny or discipline licenses
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes refusal to issue, renew, or sanction dealer and auction licenses.

headings.title: Statutory grounds for dealer license discipline
headings.reviewNote: Lists twelve statutory causes for the department to file a disciplinary complaint with the administrative hearing commission under chapter 621.

headings.title: Complaint deadline, hearing commission sanctions, and appeal
headings.reviewNote: Sets a one-year filing limit from notice of violation, provides chapter 621 proceedings, authorizes sanctions (refusal, <2-year license, private reprimand, 1-day to 5-year probation, 1-to-6-day suspension, or revocation), and grants chapter 536 appeal rights.

headings.title: Recall and surrender of suspended or revoked plates
headings.reviewNote: Directs recall of distinctive number plates upon suspension or revocation, authorizes department agents or law enforcement to seize unreturned items, and makes failure to surrender a class A misdemeanor.

headings.title: Clear and present danger grounds for expedited discipline
headings.reviewNote: Deems lapsed surety bond/letter of credit, failure to maintain a bona fide place of business, qualifying criminal convictions, or three or more established chapter violations a clear and present danger warranting expedited discipline.

headings.title: Expedited director hearing, notice, order, and closure
headings.reviewNote: Establishes director or hearing-officer evidentiary hearings for subsection 5 causes with 10-day notice and affidavits, written orders within 20 business days effective in 10 days, chapter 536 judicial review, and closed proceedings until final.

headings.title: Compliance agreements and assessment fees in lieu of discipline
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the department to enter compliance agreements in lieu of subsection 2 or 6 action, including assessment fees up to $500 per violation or $5,000 aggregate deposited into the Motor Vehicle Commission Fund and probation terms.

entries.reviewSummary: Authorizes subpoenas, witness depositions, and contempt proceedings for department administrative hearings.

headings.title: Subpoena authority and deposition procedures
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes director and hearing officers to issue subpoenas and depositions.

headings.title: Criminal penalty for subpoena disobedience
headings.reviewNote: Makes refusal to obey subpoena or testify a class B misdemeanor.

entries.reviewSummary: Authorizes law enforcement and department inspection of dealer vehicle titles, odometers, and sales records.

headings.title: Inspection of vehicle titles and odometer records
headings.reviewNote: Requires licensed dealers to permit inspection of titles, affidavits, and records.

headings.title: Definition of law enforcement official under statute
headings.reviewNote: Defines law enforcement officials authorized to inspect dealer documents.

entries.reviewSummary: Authorizes circuit court injunctions against unlicensed vehicle dealership operations and statutory violations.

headings.title: Court injunctions for unlicensed vehicle dealership operations
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes courts to enjoin unlicensed operations and chapter violations.

headings.title: Injunctive relief cumulative to other remedies
headings.reviewNote: Specifies injunction remedy is additional to other legal sanctions.

entries.reviewSummary: Regulates off-premise motor vehicle sales, recreational vehicle shows, financial institution events, and penalties.

headings.title: Prohibition on sales away from registered premises
headings.reviewNote: Makes off-premise sales unlawful except for permitted deliveries and shows.

headings.title: Off-site sales with credit union membership
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes off-site sales of fleet vehicles in conjunction with credit unions.

headings.title: Off-site sales with financial institutions
headings.reviewNote: Permits annual off-site vehicle sales on financial institution premises.

headings.title: Requirements for off-premise motor vehicle sales events
headings.reviewNote: Specifies five-day limit, fee caps, ten-mile radius, and dealer notice rules.

headings.title: Deemed business location and auction exclusion
headings.reviewNote: Treats compliant shows as proper locations and exempts vehicle auctions.

headings.title: Out-of-state RV dealers at shows with under 50 exhibitors
headings.reviewNote: Permits an out-of-state licensed recreational vehicle dealer with manufacturer permission to participate in Missouri RV shows with fewer than 50 exhibitors if at least 10 and over 50% of dealers are Missouri-licensed and the dealer's contiguous home state grants reciprocal privileges.

headings.title: Out-of-state RV dealers at large manufacturer-funded shows
headings.reviewNote: Permits out-of-state licensed recreational vehicle dealers to participate in trade-oriented Missouri shows with at least 50 RV dealers that are predominantly funded by RV manufacturers, provided out-of-state dealers are licensed in their state of residence.

headings.title: Advance written notice to department by out-of-state RV dealers
headings.reviewNote: Requires out-of-state recreational vehicle dealers to notify the department in writing at least 30 days before a Missouri show and directs the department to notify noncompliant dealers at least 15 days before the show.

headings.title: Civil fine up to $1,000 for off-premise violations
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the department to assess a fine of up to $1,000 for the off-premise sale or display of any motor vehicle in violation of this section.

entries.reviewSummary: Regulates motor vehicle dealer advertising practices, prohibits deceptive claims, and mandates disclosures.

headings.title: Prohibited deceptive advertising practices and disclosures
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits misleading claims, price distortions, and unverified terms.

headings.title: Application to print, broadcast, and electronic media
headings.reviewNote: Applies advertising rules to all media and permits website disclaimers.

headings.title: Mandatory display of licensed dealership name
headings.reviewNote: Requires dealers clearly identify themselves by registered name in ads.

entries.reviewSummary: Authorizes out-of-state show promoters to conduct recreational vehicle exhibitions and sets violation fines.

headings.title: Conditions for out-of-state RV show promoters
headings.reviewNote: Requires minimum of ten licensed dealers and majority Missouri dealers.

headings.title: Five thousand dollar fine for unauthorized shows
headings.reviewNote: Imposes five thousand dollar fine for violation of promoter show conditions.

entries.reviewSummary: Prohibits unlicensed sale of six or more motor vehicles in calendar year, establishes complaints, and penalties.

headings.title: Unlawful sale of six or more vehicles
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits selling or displaying six or more vehicles annually without license.

headings.title: Complaints to county prosecuting attorney
headings.reviewNote: Directs citizen complaints to prosecuting attorney for investigation.

headings.title: Prima facie evidence of dealer activity
headings.reviewNote: Treats transaction of six or more vehicles as prima facie dealer intent.

headings.title: Class A misdemeanor and felony penalties
headings.reviewNote: Makes initial violation class A misdemeanor and subsequent class E felony.

headings.title: Exemption for estate liquidations
headings.reviewNote: Exempts liquidation of estates from vehicle sales licensure threshold.

entries.reviewSummary: Defines mobility motor vehicles and dealers, authorizes franchised dealer acquisition, fitting, and advertising.

headings.title: Definitions for mobility vehicles and dealers
headings.reviewNote: Defines mobility motor vehicles, equipment modifications, and dealers.

headings.title: Authority to acquire and fit new vehicles
headings.reviewNote: Permits mobility dealers to purchase vehicles from franchised dealers for modification.

headings.title: Advertising restriction prior to modification
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits advertising vehicles for resale until mobility fitting is complete.

headings.title: Prohibition on displaying unmodified new vehicles
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits a mobility motor vehicle dealer from displaying or offering to display a new motor vehicle that is not a mobility motor vehicle to the public, except as permitted under subsection 2(2).

entries.reviewSummary: Regulates special event motor vehicle auctions, licensing qualifications, fees, surety bonds, and penalties.

headings.title: Definition of special event auction
headings.reviewNote: Defines three-day classic auctions where vehicles are ten years old.

headings.title: Status as public motor vehicle auction
headings.reviewNote: Classifies special event auction as public auction under regulatory statutes.

headings.title: Exemption from general dealer requirements
headings.reviewNote: Exempts special event auctions from general dealer location standards.

headings.title: Ninety-day advance application deadline
headings.reviewNote: Requires license application at least ninety days before auction event.

headings.title: Annual limit of three auctions per applicant
headings.reviewNote: Restricts applicants to three special event auctions each calendar year.

headings.title: Ten-day inventory report and misdemeanor penalty
headings.reviewNote: Mandates detailed vehicle report within ten days and makes violation misdemeanor.

headings.title: Sales tax license compliance responsibility
headings.reviewNote: Requires licensee ensure appropriate sales tax licenses are obtained.

headings.title: Special event license fee and violations
headings.reviewNote: Establishes one thousand dollar license fee and five hundred dollar violation fee.

headings.title: Department rulemaking on license denial causes
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes department to establish additional grounds for license denial.

headings.title: Three-day consecutive duration limitation
headings.reviewNote: Limits duration of special event auction to three consecutive days.

headings.title: Missouri business registration requirement
headings.reviewNote: Requires auction applicant be registered to conduct business in Missouri.

headings.title: One hundred thousand dollar surety bond
headings.reviewNote: Requires corporate surety bond or letter of credit in sum of one hundred thousand.

headings.title: Prohibition on dealer plates and temporary permit booklets
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits issuing dealer, driveaway, auction, or wholesale plates or temporary permit booklets in conjunction with a special event motor vehicle auction license.

headings.title: Seller contact information required for buyers
headings.reviewNote: Requires any person or entity selling a vehicle at a special event motor vehicle auction to provide current contact information (including name, address, and telephone number) to the buyer.

headings.title: Rulemaking authority and statutory compliance
headings.reviewNote: Grants administrative rulemaking authority under chapter 536.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs perfection of liens and encumbrances on motor vehicles and trailers, notices of lien, and out-of-state perfection.

headings.title: Exclusivity and validity of vehicle liens
headings.reviewNote: Establishes exclusive method for perfecting motor vehicle and trailer liens.

headings.title: Perfection procedures and notice of lien
headings.reviewNote: Perfects a lien by delivering a notice of lien (with owner/secured party details and VIN) to the director of revenue, effective as of creation if delivered within 30 days; validates minor non-misleading errors and requires confirmation within 15 business days.

headings.title: Lien perfection on refinanced loans by a different lender
headings.reviewNote: Provides that on a refinance by a different lender of a prior loan secured by a motor vehicle or trailer, the lien is perfected by delivering a notice of lien completed by the refinancing lender to the director of revenue.

headings.title: Perfection of subordinate liens
headings.reviewNote: Requires a notice of lien for a subordinate lien to be accompanied by the documents required under section 301.620(3).

headings.title: Liens securing future advances
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes liens securing future advances when stated on the security agreement and noted as 'subject to future advances' on the notice of lien (and certificate of ownership if only one lien), and governs perfection and proof.

headings.title: Perfection of out-of-state vehicle liens
headings.reviewNote: Establishes rules for perfecting liens on vehicles brought into Missouri.

headings.title: Security procedures for electronic lien notices
headings.reviewNote: Mandates security procedures for electronic lien filings and confirmations.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs delivery of certificates of ownership, electronic title retention by director, and lienholder elections.

headings.title: Certificate mailing and electronic confirmation
headings.reviewNote: Directs title mailing to owner or electronic confirmation to first lienholder.

headings.title: Lienholder election for electronic retention
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes lienholder election for state electronic certificate retention.

headings.title: Definition of electronic certificate of ownership
headings.reviewNote: Defines electronic certificate of ownership as electronic title record.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes procedures for assigning vehicle liens and encumbrances and perfecting assignments on title records.

headings.title: Assignment of lien and lienholder liability
headings.reviewNote: Allows lienholder assignment while protecting parties without notice.

headings.title: Perfection of assignment on certificate of ownership
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes assignee to deliver title and assignment form to director.

headings.title: Assignment update on electronic title records
headings.reviewNote: Requires director update electronic title upon notice of assignment.

entries.reviewSummary: Regulates release of liens on motor vehicles and trailers, electronic releases, liquidated damages, and penalties.

headings.title: Lien release upon payment satisfaction
headings.reviewNote: Requires lienholder execute release and deliver title within five business days.

headings.title: Notice of release for electronic certificates
headings.reviewNote: Mandates lienholder notify director within five business days of release.

headings.title: Statutory expiration of older small liens
headings.reviewNote: Deems non-bank liens on vehicles under six thousand satisfied in six years.

headings.title: Liquidated damages for delayed lien releases
headings.reviewNote: Imposes tiered liquidated damages up to twenty-five hundred for delay.

headings.title: Class D felony for unauthorized lien release
headings.reviewNote: Classifies intentional unauthorized lien release filing as class D felony.

entries.reviewSummary: Authorizes electronic signatures on documents assigning ownership of total loss vehicles to insurance companies.

headings.title: Electronic signature on total loss documents
headings.reviewNote: Allows electronic signature without notarization on insurer loss powers of attorney.

headings.title: Rulemaking authority under chapter 536
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes director of revenue to promulgate administrative rules.

entries.reviewSummary: Defines scope and statutory exemptions from motor vehicle lien perfection laws and establishes exclusivity.

headings.title: Statutory exemptions from vehicle lien laws
headings.reviewNote: Exempts mechanic liens, tax liens, inventory liens, and child support.

headings.title: Exclusive method of lien perfection
headings.reviewNote: Declares statutory lien perfection method exclusive for vehicles.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs transfer of motor vehicle certificates of ownership upon death of co-owners and tenants in common.

headings.title: Transfer to surviving joint co-owners
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes title transfer to surviving owners upon proof of co-owner death.

headings.title: Transfer for tenants in common upon death
headings.reviewNote: Requires application by survivors and personal representative for tenancy in common.

entries.reviewSummary: Authorizes transfer on death certificates of ownership for vehicles and trailers and regulates beneficiary rights.

headings.title: Directive to transfer title on death
headings.reviewNote: Allows sole or joint owners to direct title transfer to TOD beneficiaries.

headings.title: Prohibition on tenancy in common TOD titles
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits beneficiary form for titles held as tenants in common.

headings.title: TOD and transfer on death wording format
headings.reviewNote: Requires TOD or transfer on death to wording after owner names.

headings.title: Owner rights, revocation, and lifetime claims
headings.reviewNote: Provides owner retains full lifetime rights and governs revocation methods.

headings.title: Title issuance to beneficiary and non-testamentary nature
headings.reviewNote: Directs new title issuance upon proof of death and confirms non-testamentary status.

entries.reviewSummary: Regulates operation of all-terrain vehicles, private property consent, sovereign immunity, and youth supervision.

headings.title: Private property consent and identification
headings.reviewNote: Bans ATV operation on private land without consent and requires removal upon request.

headings.title: State road closure authority and public notice
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes state road closures to vehicular traffic with adequate notice.

headings.title: Sovereign immunity applicable to public land ATVs
headings.reviewNote: Applies governmental sovereign immunity doctrine to ATV accidents on public lands.

headings.title: Direct adult supervision for youth operators
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits unsupervised ATV operation by persons under age sixteen.

entries.reviewSummary: Requires all-terrain vehicle registration with department of revenue, specifies exemptions, and sets age limits.

headings.title: Registration requirement for all-terrain vehicles
headings.reviewNote: Mandates state registration with department before operating ATVs.

headings.title: Governmental and nonresident registration exemptions
headings.reviewNote: Exempts government-owned ATVs and temporary nonresidents under thirty days.

headings.title: Sixteen-year minimum age for registration
headings.reviewNote: Bans registration of all-terrain vehicles by persons under age sixteen.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs all-terrain vehicle registration decals, three-year registration terms, replacement decals, and fees.

headings.title: Decal issuance and display on front fork
headings.reviewNote: Directs issuance of registration decal and display on right front fork.

headings.title: Three-year registration fee and delinquent penalty
headings.reviewNote: Sets ten dollar fee for three-year term and five dollar delinquent penalty.

headings.title: Duplicate certificate and replacement decal application
headings.reviewNote: Provides for duplicate decal upon affidavit and seven-fifty fee within five days.

headings.title: Deposit of fees into general revenue fund
headings.reviewNote: Requires deposit of ATV registration fees in state general revenue fund.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes enforcement procedures for all-terrain vehicle violations, infractions, and prosecutorial referrals.

headings.title: Infraction classification and peace officer enforcement
headings.reviewNote: Classifies violations of sections 301.700 to 301.714 as infractions and authorizes arrest or summons by political-subdivision law enforcement officers and the highway patrol. Source notes: referenced section 577.065 was repealed effective Jan 1, 2017; 'and' before 'the highway patrol' does not appear in original rolls.

headings.title: Prosecutorial referral and court proceedings
headings.reviewNote: Permits referral of ATV violations to local prosecuting attorney.

headings.title: Preservation of statutory and common law crimes
headings.reviewNote: Clarifies that ATV statutes do not limit criminal prosecution under other laws.

entries.reviewSummary: Authorizes collegiate registration and title for solar-powered vehicles competing in national collegiate contests.

headings.title: Collegiate solar-powered vehicle registration
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes university solar-powered competition vehicles to be registered and titled.

headings.title: Affidavit application by higher education institution
headings.reviewNote: Requires university to file verified application form with director.

headings.title: Collegiate plate with solar designation
headings.reviewNote: Prescribes issuance of collegiate plate displaying the term solar.

headings.title: Payment of applicable administrative fees
headings.reviewNote: Requires institution to pay registration fees determined by director.

headings.title: Inspection exemptions and highway operation approval
headings.reviewNote: Exempts solar vehicles from inspections and limits operation to institution approval.
